description:
VirtualDojo AI CRM is a cloud-based customer relationship management
platform with AI-powered proposal generation, contact management,
pipeline forecasting, and document automation. The platform is designed
for government contractors and federal agencies managing procurement
workflows, storing Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) including
government contract data, customer PII, proposal documents, and
financial/pricing data.
